API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIApp Connector ManagementUpdates the App Connector details for the specified ID.
Updates the App Connector details for the specified ID.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/connector/:connectorId

Updates the App Connector details for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

connectorId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the App Connector.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Possible values: [UNKNOWN, ZPN_STATUS_AUTHENTICATED, ZPN_STATUS_DISCONNECTED]
